ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Clay & Atmosphere. An advanced studio course in ceramics, focusing on the special topics of firing high and low temperature clays in combustion atmospheres. Students will explore and develop their conceptual and aesthetic interests, topics, and projects; systematically cultivate an expanding and refined lexicon of materials and process, knowledge and expertise; and develop research strategies and methodologies in the service of their work. Projects will be based on self-generated responses to course prompts, and incorporate dynamic group and individual discussion and critique with faculty and peers. Prerequisite: ARTS 210 (Ceramics Sculpture I). The class meets: 2110 S. Griffith Dr., Bldg 4. Undergraduate section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
